purpose: Privacy-preserving measurement contract for ShopNow Kitchen. No cookies, no third-party pixels, no device fingerprinting, and no raw search text transmitted.

outbound_click.fires_when: A tagged Amazon affiliate link ([data-outbound]) is clicked
outbound_click.used_for: Measuring which product a reader clicks out to

guide_read.fires_when: A buying guide under guides/ finishes loading
guide_read.used_for: Separating guide consumption from catalog navigation

search.fires_when: On-site search evaluates a non-empty query on search.html
search.used_for: Detecting zero-result searches via query length and match count without recording raw user text

suggestion_rank.fires_when: A proposal row on suggestions.html is moved up or down
suggestion_rank.used_for: Recording reviewer priority ordering in Decision Center

transport.default_mode: localStorage-only (static GitHub Pages; send() is a no-op until sn_collect_url or meta[name=sn-collect-endpoint] is configured)
